plugin.name: Burnout 3 PCSX2F Fusion Fix
FOVFactor.description: Adjusts the driving camera's horizontal field of view. Higher values show more of the road. Changes apply during play.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the legal notice, the Criterion logo and the opening video at startup, straight to the Press START screen. Restart the game to apply.
ForceAspectRatio.description: Auto follows the emulator display. Override with a width:height ratio or decimal; set the emulator display to the same ratio. Changes apply during play.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places side-anchored HUD elements at the screen edges. A ratio limits those anchors to a centered box. Changes apply during play.
HudScale.description: Changes the size of anchored driving HUD elements. Changes apply during play.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original keeps the game’s framing. Fill shows the whole movie as large as the screen allows, without cutting off the picture.
MouseSensitivity.description: Controls how quickly mouse movement turns the driving camera.
GamepadCameraSpeed.description: Adjust the speed of the right-stick driving camera.
InvertGamepadY.description: Reverse the vertical right-stick camera direction.
SplitScreenSideBySide.description: Use side-by-side views in the next split-screen race.
FPSLimit.description: Choose the original game rate or the 60 FPS mode. Restart the game to apply.
